turnos.t: Why can't a business just keep every stakeholder happy?
Because resources are limited and objectives differ. Money paid in wages can't also be paid in dividends. If wages rise, costs rise and profit falls, so employees and shareholders clash.

Customers want low prices; shareholders want margins. Local job-seekers want a new factory; environmental groups fear pollution. Every decision creates winners and losers. But look for win-win options too: that's a high-band move.
